infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PlantR uses the camera to scan plant QR codes and to take plant photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PlantR records the GPS location of each scan so plants can be shown on the property map.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PlantR can pull plant photos from your library.
